items.title: fix(update): finish deferred migrations from older updaters (#149913)
items.summary: fix(update): finish deferred migrations from older updaters (#149913) Fix updates started by published parents through 2026.9.2 reporting success before the fresh child finishes deferred Doctor migrations. Current parents declare completion ownership in their temporary handoff; absent ownership preserves the shipped child-owned contract. The child runs Doctor outside the plugin lease and settles validation before publishing its result. Keep Doctor and the existing retained-source verifier as the owners. Share archive lookup and source verification only within the synchronous receipt/counting phase, with fresh verification after awaited publication. Preserve #150015's orphan and trajectory capture, shared archive reporting, source identities, and pending-generation guards. No durable schema or operator configuration changes. Thanks to @fuller-stack-dev (Jason (Json)) for the diagnosis and original repair in #145043. The completion repair and qualified post-install Doctor advisory handling are extracted and adapted from that work. Validation: exact-head CI run 35163324449 is green on 4819bfe9f7370c341d3df2fa87c2c81079e47486. All 368 focused tests across 11 files passed, including 79 CI-plan tests; changed-file checks, the line-cap ratchet, and fresh Codex P1 review passed. Earlier published-updater AWS evidence is retained at its recorded candidate; the full live matrix was not repeated after reconciliation. The historical volume archive failure belongs to the separate source-capture repair in #150015. Refs #145043 Co-authored-by: Jason (Json) Co-authored-by: Jason (Json)
